Bonus · Verification signals
Trust signals brands can see at a glance
Identity
Is the creator a real, checked person?
Tool usage
Do project files prove the tools claimed?
Workflow review
Was the process walked through and reviewed?
Verified
Self-reported
Not provided
Each signal has one of three states, and brands can filter to verified creators only.
States are demo data and labelled as such. A badge never replaces a rights check in the brief.

Creatify AI · Briefs · 20% of the score
07
Bonus · AI-assisted brief builder
A rough idea in, a structured brief out
You type
“I need a cinematic of a car for 5 seconds”
It returns
Draft: Video, 9:16, 5 s
Suggested skills: cinematography, editing, prompt direction
Missing: title, brand, audience, budget, deadline, deliverables
It fills only what the text states, labels every suggestion, and lists gaps. Rule-based today, ready for a language model.

User experience
Short, clear flows for both sides
Brand flow
  1. Sign up as a brand
  2. Search and filter creators
  3. Open profile and portfolio
  4. Save, hire or send a brief
  5. Track it all in the dashboard
Creator flow
  1. Sign up as a creator
  2. Build profile and portfolio
  3. Browse open briefs
  4. Apply with a message
  5. Answer hire requests
Animated intro, dark responsive interface, dashboard with saved creators and activity, clear errors on every form.

Creatify AI · Data model
15
Quality and safety
Built to be trusted, and tested
Accounts
Passwords hashed with scrypt. Signed login tokens that expire after 7 days.
Data safety
Owners only can edit profiles, briefs and requests. Inputs validated with field errors.
Web hardening
Rate limits, 1 MB request cap, CORS allow-list, safe-URL checks, security headers.
Tested
Four automated suites: core API, hiring, and two AI-provider mocks. All pass.
